submission.justification: Recommend Mixture-G1 at a 1.98 mm gas gap. Among the candidates, Mixture-G3 gives the fastest simulated timing but is the standard fluorinated mixture and is therefore not compatible with the low-GWP policy threshold. Mixture-G2 is the newer-replacement option but fails the hard 1.5 ns timing requirement throughout the simulated 1--3 mm gap range (about 2.0 ns or worse near its optimum). Mixture-G1 is the low-GWP partial-substitute candidate and meets the timing requirement; a targeted scan around the 2 mm operating point found the best simulated value at 1.98 mm, with time resolution 1.228 ns in a 100000-event Garfield++ avalanche simulation. The nearby 2 mm point is also supported by the 2025 summary value of 1.3 ns, so the recommendation has margin below 1.5 ns.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: For the environmentally acceptable candidates, simulations show Mixture-G1 near 2 mm has the best timing. The targeted scan gave 1.228 ns at 1.98 mm; Mixture-G2 was about 2.0 ns or worse over 1--3 mm. Mixture-G3 is faster (about 0.9 ns near 2 mm) but is excluded by the GWP constraint.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Mixture-G1, Mixture-G2, and Mixture-G3; the recommendation selects Mixture-G1.

requirements.requirement: The time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.
requirements.evidence: Garfield++ simulation for Mixture-G1 at 1.98 mm returned 1.228 ns using 100000 events; supporting scans near 1.8--2.4 mm and the 2025 2 mm summary (~1.3 ns) are also below 1.5 ns.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 is the partial-substitute low-GWP candidate in candidate_specs.md and is selected instead of the standard fluorinated Mixture-G3. This is the candidate compatible with the laboratory GWP100 <= 150 policy while retaining acceptable timing.
The recommended 1.98 mm gap lies within the allowed 1--3 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Mixture-G1 at 1.98 mm.
